La note contient une dépense billet d'avion de 6800 NOK
La note contient une dépense taxi de 500 NOK

If not found, create employee with name Arthur Petit and email arthur.petit@example.org via employee endpoint
Create travel expense for employee with description/title 'Visite client Oslo' via travel expense endpoint
Add per diem line: quantity 5, rate 800 NOK
Add expense line for billet d'avion: amount 6800 NOK
Add expense line for taxi: amount 500 NOK
Validate total amount equals 11300 NOK and save/submit the travel expense

payload.headline: Travel expense created but per diem used cost lines instead of perDiemCompensation endpoint
what_went_wrong: perDiemCompensation POST failed twice (422): first due to 'Country not enabled' with countryCode=NO, then 'Spesifiser avreisedato og returdato' - departure/return dates missing from perDiem record
Agent fell back to creating per diem as a regular cost line (4000 NOK) instead of properly using the perDiemCompensation endpoint, likely causing scoring failure
Redundant GET /travelExpense/costCategory called 3 times and GET /travelExpense/rateCategory called 4 times without extracting useful data, wasting 5+ API calls
Score returned None/None with 0/0 checks passed, suggesting the task structure may not have been evaluated or the per diem approach was fundamentally wrong
what_worked: Employee lookup succeeded immediately, finding Arthur Petit (id: 18180693)
Travel expense header created successfully (id: 11145457) and cost lines for flight/taxi posted without errors
what_to_try_next: For perDiemCompensation, include departureDate and returnDate fields directly in the POST body (not just on the parent travelExpense), and omit countryCode or use the correct enabled country value
Eliminate redundant costCategory and rateCategory GET calls - fetch once, cache results, and proceed; this would cut ~5 unnecessary API calls

Investigate whether the scoring system expects per diem via perDiemCompensation endpoint specifically (not as a cost line) and ensure the travelExpense has proper departure/return dates set before adding per diem lines
unnecessary_calls: GET /travelExpense/costCategory called 3 times - should be called once and results reused
GET /travelExpense/rateCategory called 4 times - redundant repeated calls with no new data extracted
POST /travelExpense/perDiemCompensation with countryCode=NO - known to fail; should have inspected endpoint schema first to find required date fields
